words.example: My sister is watching a new series about doctors.

example_translations.ru: Моя сестра смотрит новый сериал о врачах.
example_translations.uz: Singlim shifokorlar haqidagi yangi serialni tomosha qilyapti.

words.example: The last episode ended with a big surprise.

example_translations.uz: Oxirgi qism katta syurpriz bilan tugadi.

words.example: The first scene of the movie is very funny.
The plot of this movie is hard to follow.

example_translations.ru: За сюжетом этого фильма трудно следить.
example_translations.uz: Bu filmning syujetini kuzatib borish qiyin.

words.example: My favorite character is the old detective.
Comedy is my favorite movie genre.
The director told the actors where to stand.
All the actors read the script before filming.

example_translations.ru: Все актёры прочитали сценарий перед съёмками.
example_translations.uz: Barcha aktyorlar suratga olish oldidan ssenariyni o'qib chiqdi.

words.example: Have you seen the trailer for the new movie?
I watch movies in English with subtitles.

example_translations.ru: Я смотрю фильмы на английском с субтитрами.
example_translations.uz: Men ingliz tilidagi filmlarni subtitrlar bilan ko'raman.

words.example: The filmmaker shot the movie near her hometown.

example_translations.ru: Кинематографистка сняла фильм недалеко от своего родного города.
example_translations.uz: Kino ijodkori filmni o'z tug'ilgan shahri yaqinida suratga oldi.

words.example: The animator drew hundreds of pictures for one scene.

example_translations.ru: Художник-мультипликатор нарисовал сотни рисунков для одной сцены.
example_translations.uz: Multfilm rassomi bitta sahna uchun yuzlab rasm chizdi.

words.example: We watched a sitcom about two roommates.

example_translations.ru: Мы посмотрели комедийный сериал про двух соседей по комнате.
example_translations.uz: Ikki xonadosh haqidagi komediya serialini ko'rdik.

words.example: The prequel shows the hero as a child.

example_translations.uz: Oldingi voqealar haqidagi filmda qahramonning bolaligi ko'rsatilgan.

words.example: The remake follows the same story as the original.

example_translations.uz: Qayta ishlangan film asl film syujetini takrorlaydi.
